conventions.children: every asset root has exactly the children Visual and Collision
conventions.collision_semantics: StaticBody3D presentation envelope with CollisionShape3D disabled and collision_layer/collision_mask 0; it documents bounds only and never grants authority or controller truth
conventions.runtime_truth_boundary: presentation only; authoritative collision/integration belongs to A world_authority in a separate process

engine.note: expected version/hash taken from A greybox_drill_envelope.md; this catalog was produced without running Godot; on the first real engine run, execute simulator/tests/test_asset_contract.gd and record the printed MEASURE lines as measured evidence

provenance_rules.all_assets: original procedural geometry authored by the B asset domain in this repository; no downloaded models, textures, scans or third-party installers; license see simulator/assets/LICENSES.md
provenance_rules.bounds: declared envelope is the closed-form design bound; measured AABB values below come from the independent double-precision Python replica of the exact generator formulas (replica script recorded in evidence); the runtime factory re-measures actual transformed mesh vertices and stores geometry_bounds_m and pivot_bound_radius_m as metadata on every instance
provenance_rules.volumes: mesh volume computed by divergence theorem over the same triangles; star-mesh volumes are replica values for the exact deterministic vertex formulas; fault and casing are closed-form prism volumes

assets.description: PDC-style cutter head with six visual blades and eighteen cutter studs, metal matrix body, threaded joint and short collar; decorative geometry only, presentation only

measured_replica.pivot_radius_method: maximum |v| over all transformed mesh vertices in the double-precision replica; the factory recomputes this from the actual engine mesh and sets pivot_bound_radius_m (never a stamped guess)

assets.triangles_note: analytic estimate from segment counts; test_asset_contract.gd prints the exact engine value
